text:
Maria: FYI rolled a small 5% canary of v5.2-quant4 (longdoc optimizer) earlier. Shadow vs v5.1-fp16 shows a concentrated rerank MRR drop on >2k token slice (~-11%-13%) and p95 latency up ~25-35ms. Not seeing halluc spikes, looks like scoring mismatch when KV warmup is low. anyone seen similar quant long-doc behavior? :thinking_face:

Kai: pasted shadow run summary — regression correlates with low kv warmup counts:
```
slice=longdoc_top10
metric=rerank_mrr
v5.1-fp16=0.424
v5.2-quant4=0.372
delta=-0.052 (-12.3%)
latency.p95: 175ms -> 205ms
kv_warmup_miss_rate: 0.9% -> 2.7%
```
this smells like kv restore noise + increased token variance from quantized kernels.

Devin: our current canary auto-fallbacks are set to mrr_drop 7% and halluc_abs 2%. For longdocs we should be stricter. Proposal: immediate auto-fallback if any of these: mrr_drop > 5% OR p95_latency_increase > 20ms OR kv_warmup_miss_rate > 1%. That would've aborted this canary.

Maria: agreed. updating rollout policy now. patch snippet to apply to the canary config:
```yaml
canary_percent: 5
auto_fallback:
  - name: rerank_mrr
    comparator: pct_drop
    threshold: 5.0
    window_sec: 600
  - name: latency_p95_ms
    comparator: abs_increase
    threshold: 20
    window_sec: 600
  - name: kv_warmup_miss_rate_pct
    comparator: abs_increase
    threshold: 1.0
    window_sec: 600
```
I'll reduce the live canary to 1% while we investigate and run an expanded shadow with forced kv warmup.

Kai: short-term mitigation: I'll push a routing override for the canary pool setting route-level kv_warmup=10 so caches are pre-populated for scoring requests. This doesn't change model bits, just reduces cold-kv effects. Opening CL now. :wrench:

Devin: +1 on stricter thresholds. also recommend we add a metric to compare token-level logit variance between runs (quant kernel jitter). If variance spike correlates with rerank drop, that's a fast signal for future canaries.

Maria: good idea. I'll add a lightweight variance probe to the canary dashboard and a synthetic warmup runner (100 longdoc samples) to run before canary promos.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-2043 opened: "v5.2-quant4 longdoc rerank regression (canary)". Watchers: eng-ml, eng-platform.

Maria: Plan: 1) apply auto-fallback patch (done), 2) scale canary to 1% and run broader shadow with kv_warmup=10, 3) collect variance probe + rerun quantized kernel diagnostics, 4) decide on rollback or rebaseline. Tagging @dev-sre for infra assistance. :thumbsup:
